sentences.en: Most businesses have realized that search engine optimization (SEO) is important if you want to succeed on the Internet.

sentences.en: In SEO, repetition of keywords is vital because a search-engines reputation is based on the relevance of its results.

sentences.en: Little wonder then, that most SEO revolves round Google.
